'''Dester''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] who lived on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. He tasked a Republic [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to recover the [[Water/Legends|water]] that was stolen from him by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].<ref name="TOR" />
